name: Techcombank Ho Chi Minh City International Marathon (9th ed.)
short_description: The Techcombank Ho Chi Minh City International Marathon is a full-marathon event held in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam on December 6, 2026.
ai_summary: The Techcombank Ho Chi Minh City International Marathon is the 9th edition of this marathon, scheduled for the morning of Sunday 6 December 2026 in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, with the start line at Le Duan - Nguyen Binh Khiem. Race day offers 42.195 km, 21.1 km and 10 km; from 2026 the 5 km has its own race day on Saturday 5 December. The 3 km and 1.5 km are Kids Run distances, held on the Saturday in 2025.

core_facts.venue: Le Duan - Nguyen Binh Khiem, Ho Chi Minh City

pros: Generous limits: 6 hours 30 for the marathon and 4 hours for the half
23 aid stations about every 2 km, with ice, ion drink and fruit
Flat course, never above 43 m, certified by AIMS and the Vietnam Athletics Federation
Big field of more than 23,000 runners, with official pacers from 3:30 to 5:00
cons: Very humid: 24°C and 100% humidity at the 3.30am start in 2025, 29°C by the cut-off
Roads only partly closed, with traffic beside the course
Point-to-point course means bag transfer and a shuttle back from Thu Thiem
Finisher shirt goes to marathon finishers only
research_highlights: Vietnam's largest and most established marathon, now in its 9th edition, organised by Sunrise Events.
The 7th edition drew a record field of nearly 18,000 runners from 64 countries and territories.
Listed as a full member of AIMS with M/H/R designation, and carries a World Athletics road race label.

The 2025 marathon was point to point: it started in front of Saigon Zoo and Botanical Garden, passed Notre-Dame Cathedral, ran along the Saigon River on Vo Van Kiet and crossed Thu Thiem Bridge to finish at Empire City. The 2026 start line is Le Duan - Nguyen Binh Khiem.
Registration for the 9th edition closes on 6 November 2026, a month ahead of the 6 December race date.
research_watchouts: Entry fees are tiered by registration phase and were not retrievable from the official fee page at the time of writing -- check marathonhcmc.com for the current tier before budgeting.
The official race website blocks automated access, so aggregator listings for this event cannot be cross-checked against it programmatically and may lag.

faqs.question: When is the Techcombank Ho Chi Minh City International Marathon taking place?
faqs.answer: The Techcombank Ho Chi Minh City International Marathon is scheduled to take place on December 6, 2026. This date marks the 9th edition of the race, which is held annually in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, drawing runners from various distance categories to participate in this international event.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this event?
faqs.answer: Race day on Sunday 6 December 2026 has a 42.195 km marathon, a 21.1 km half marathon and a 10 km. From 2026 the 5 km moves to its own race day, Saturday 5 December. The 3 km and 1.5 km are Kids Run distances for children aged 5 to 14, held on the Saturday in 2025.

faqs.question: Where is the marathon held?
faqs.answer: The marathon is held in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, which serves as both the venue and host city for this international running event. As the 9th edition of the race, it continues to bring together runners from multiple distance categories in this major Vietnamese city.
